```{r, include = FALSE}

  primario = "#2A3D6E",
  familia = "Poppins"
)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
options(htmltools.dir.version = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.retina=3,
```

```{r include=F, echo=F, results=F}
library(xaringanthemer)
style_mono_accent(base_color =  parametros$primario,
                  header_font_google = google_font(parametros$familia),
                  text_font_google   = google_font(parametros$familia),
                  code_font_google   = google_font(parametros$familia),
                  colors = c("rf" = parametros$sm_rf, "rc" = parametros$sm_rc,"a" = parametros$sm_a,"vc" = parametros$sm_vc, "vf" = parametros$sm_vf)
)

options(htmltools.dir.version = FALSE, htmltools.preserve.raw = FALSE)
```

